summary: Fresenius Medical Care AG filed a Form 6-K with an ad-hoc release reporting Q2 2026 results that exceeded market consensus. Operating income excluding special items was EUR 569 million, up 23% at constant currency versus consensus of EUR 515 million. Revenue rose 4% to EUR 4,861 million, slightly above consensus of EUR 4,792 million. The company confirmed its unchanged full-year 2026 outlook. This is a routine earnings announcement without any special-situation elements such as mergers, tender offers, or strategic actions. No deal terms apply. What to watch: quarterly results and outlook confirmation only.
